topic.title: mummy's gold
topic.claim: Mummy's gold isn't jewellery. It's the only money in the house in her name.
topic.moment: Mummy opens the locker, counts the bangles once, and locks it again without wearing any.

turn.believed: The gold is sentiment, saved for your wedding or hers from decades ago.
turn.actually: It's the only asset in the house that is hers, that she can move without asking anyone.

topic.because: The house is in papa's name, the accounts are joint but really his. The gold is the one thing a woman of that generation got to call her own, and keep.
topic.payoff: Everything else in the house has papa's name on it. The gold has hers. That's not jewellery, that's independence you can wear.
topic.feeling: a soft shock at how little was ever really hers
topic.villain: the arrangement where a wife's security had to be worn to be owned
topic.behaviour: mothers guard their gold, refuse to sell it, pass it down hand to hand not on paper
topic.mechanism: gold was the only asset a generation of women could own outright, so it stands for her independence not her vanity
topic.group: adult kids watching their mothers' quiet finances
topic.send_to: a sister who's about to inherit or be gifted that gold and should know what it meant
topic.why_now: wedding and Dhanteras season, when the gold comes out and goes back in
